name: hackingBuddyGPT
description: TU Wien research framework (wintermute) for LLM-driven Linux and Windows privilege escalation, web, API and Active Directory testing

indicators.context: Start of the marker hackingBuddyGPT types before every command in its persistent SSH shell on a Linux target: echo __CMDSTART_<8 hex>__ (utils/connectors/ssh_interactive_connection.py:114,121). Seen in the target account's shell history and TTY audit logs, not in process events (echo is a builtin)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the hackingBuddyGPT source code

indicators.context: Tail of the end marker hackingBuddyGPT types after every command on a Linux target: echo "__CMDEND_<8 hex>__:$?:$(id -u):$(id -un)" (ssh_interactive_connection.py:143). It also starts an id -u and an id -un process after each command
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the hackingBuddyGPT source code

indicators.context: Marker the hackingBuddyGPT local_shell connector types through tmux send-keys before each command: echo 'CMDSTART<8 hex>', then echo 'CMDEND<8 hex>' after it (utils/connectors/local_shell.py:171-183). Seen in tmux process command lines and shell history on the operator host
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the hackingBuddyGPT source code

indicators.context: Query parameter the hackingBuddyGPT WebAPITesting discovery code appends to an endpoint in its query step, sent with python-requests (usecases/web_api/detection_response_handler.py:413). A documentation placeholder, so a developer may send it too
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the hackingBuddyGPT source code

indicators.context: Path requested by hackingBuddyGPT WebAPITesting: a missing comma joins '/products/{id}' and '/users/profile' in its common-path list and {id} becomes 1 (detection_response_handler.py:59-60,249). A real application may have this route
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the hackingBuddyGPT source code

indicators.context: Victim e-mail in the hackingBuddyGPT WebAPITesting OTP brute-force test, sent with password Az123### and OTP 8859 first (utils/prompt_generation/information/_pentesting_auth.py:530-542). It is the victim account of the OWASP crAPI training API, so crAPI walkthroughs send it too
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the hackingBuddyGPT source code

indicators.context: E-mail value of the hackingBuddyGPT login SQL injection test, sent as {'email': "' or 1=1--", 'password': 'a', 'x': <counter>} (utils/prompt_generation/information/_pentesting_injection.py:181). The payload is generic; the x field is the tool's account counter
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the hackingBuddyGPT source code
